metadata.title: Server Runtime Protection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for observing and assessing server runtime behavior to identify malicious or anomalous activity.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Server runtime execution environments, processes, kernel activity, system calls, and runtime telemetry sources.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Supporting Zero Trust pattern defining runtime behavior assessment as a source of security signals, not enforcement.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines runtime execution observations as behavioral and risk data used for detection and trust decisions, not entitlement.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Control catalog governing malicious code protection, system monitoring, and runtime integrity (SI, CM families).

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Conceptual and architectural grounding for detecting malicious activity during system operation.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Continuous monitoring guidance establishing runtime activity as an ongoing assessment signal.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust guidance defining runtime signals as conditional inputs to access and trust decisions.

metadata.remarks: Server Runtime Protection defines mechanisms for observing and assessing runtime behavior of servers to identify malicious or anomalous activity. This pattern produces runtime risk signals only and does not perform blocking, remediation, isolation, patching, or response actions.

components.title: Server Runtime Telemetry
components.description: Collection of security‑relevant runtime execution data from servers.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Execution of malicious commands or scripts during runtime.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Runtime telemetry provides visibility into execution behavior.

implemented-requirements.remarks: System monitoring captures runtime security-relevant activity.

components.title: Runtime Behavior Analysis
components.description: Analysis of runtime telemetry to detect anomalous or malicious behavior.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of system services to execute malicious code.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Behavioral analysis detects deviation from expected execution patterns.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Malicious code is detected during execution.

components.title: Runtime Risk Signaling
components.description: Generation of runtime risk signals for downstream trust, admission, and access decisions.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit signaling prevents ambiguous interpretation of runtime findings.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Runtime risk signals inform risk‑based trust decisions.
